pages.text: when ordinary dungeons feel manageable, the harbinger is the usual first cataclysm boss - its ruined citadel shows up on the xaero world map as you explore. read up on how the fight starts before you knock.$(br2)bring your best gear, useful spells, and enough supplies for a longer fight. set a meeting point outside the structure if you're going with friends.
aim for one dead boss, on purpose, with witnesses.
